title: Library Repositories
description: Configures where CODESYS 4 looks for managed libraries. For most cases only 'localRepositories' is needed; 'storages' and 'c4LibraryRepositories' offer the full, advanced configuration.

storages.title: Storages
storages.description: Named storage backends that physically hold libraries. A repository refers to a storage by its name.

defaultSnippets.label: Example file system storage
defaultSnippets.description: A storage backed by a directory on disk.

c4LibraryRepositories.title: Library repositories
c4LibraryRepositories.description: The configured library repositories. Each entry has a 'kind' that selects its behavior (local, remote, cached or combined).

defaultSnippets.label: Example local repository
defaultSnippets.description: A local repository backed by the 'MyStorage' storage above.

localRepositories.title: Local Repositories
localRepositories.description: Simple configuration for local library repositories. Key is the repository name, value is the path to the repository root directory. Set a value to null to disable a repository of that name that was defined on a lower layer or contributed by an extension.

defaultSnippets.label: Example repository path
defaultSnippets.description: Path to the repository root directory.

defaultSnippets.label: Disable this repository
defaultSnippets.description: null disables a repository of that name defined on a lower layer or contributed by an extension.

fileSystemStorage.title: File system storage
fileSystemStorage.description: A storage backed by a directory on disk.

defaultSnippets.label: File system storage
defaultSnippets.description: A storage backed by a directory on disk.

rootDirectory.title: Root directory
rootDirectory.description: Path to the directory that holds the libraries.

createIfNotExisting.title: Create if not existing
createIfNotExisting.description: If true, the directory is created when it does not exist; if false, it must already exist.

deleteOnDispose.title: Delete on dispose
deleteOnDispose.description: If true, the directory is deleted when the storage is disposed. Use with extreme caution.

s3Storage.title: S3 storage
s3Storage.description: A storage backed by an S3-compatible object store.

region.title: Region
region.description: The AWS region endpoint. If omitted, the AWS fallback region resolution is used.

serviceUrl.title: Service URL
serviceUrl.description: Service URL of an S3-compatible provider other than AWS.

createIfNotExisting.title: Create if not existing
createIfNotExisting.description: If true, the bucket is created when it does not exist; if false, it must already exist.

deleteOnDispose.title: Delete on dispose
deleteOnDispose.description: If true, the bucket is deleted when the storage is disposed. Use with extreme caution.

localRepository.title: Local repository
localRepository.description: A repository whose libraries live directly in a storage.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

cachedRepository.title: Cached repository
cachedRepository.description: A repository that caches the content of another repository into a local storage.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

combinedRepository.title: Combined repository
combinedRepository.description: A repository that presents several source repositories as one.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

sourceRepositories.title: Source repositories
sourceRepositories.description: Names of the repositories to combine, in priority order.

proxyRepository.title: Proxy repository
proxyRepository.description: A repository that proxies a source repository and periodically refreshes a local proxy storage.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

updateIntervalInMinutes.title: Update interval (minutes)
updateIntervalInMinutes.description: How often the proxy refreshes from its source, in minutes.

redirectedRepository.title: Redirected repository
redirectedRepository.description: A repository that rewrites selected library requests to other libraries or repositories.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

redirections.title: Redirections
redirections.description: The redirection rules applied to the source repository.

reducedRepository.title: Reduced repository
reducedRepository.description: A repository that exposes only a filtered subset of a source repository.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

predicates.title: Predicates
predicates.description: The rules selecting which libraries pass the filter.

positiveMatch.title: Positive match
positiveMatch.description: If true the predicates select what is kept; if false they select what is excluded.

remoteRepository.title: Remote repository
remoteRepository.description: A repository served over the network at a base address.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

remoteName.title: Remote name
remoteName.description: Name of the repository as published at the remote server (its identifier at baseAddress), not a repository defined in this file.

cachedKeysAndVersionsRepository.title: Cached keys and versions repository
cachedKeysAndVersionsRepository.description: A repository that proxies a source repository but caches only its library keys and versions (not the content) into a storage, refreshing them periodically.

isPublic.title: Is public
isPublic.description: Whether this repository is public. Public repositories are exposed for direct use; non-public ones serve only as building blocks for virtual repositories such as Combined or Cached.

checkIntervalInMinutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
checkIntervalInMinutes.description: How often the cached keys and versions are refreshed from the source, in minutes.

storageName.title: Storage name
storageName.description: Unique name of a storage defined in 'storages'.

libraryKey.title: Library key
libraryKey.description: Identifies a library as 'Title (Company)': the title, then the company in parentheses. Both parts are required — a bare title such as 'Standard' is rejected.

libraryVersion.title: Library version
libraryVersion.description: A semantic version. Two to four numeric parts, optionally followed by a pre-release label and/or build metadata (NuGet version syntax).

uri.title: URI
uri.description: An absolute URI (for example the base address of a remote repository).

redirection.title: Redirection
redirection.description: Rewrites a library request. Specify either an exact 'sourceVersion' or a 'sourceVersionFrom'/'sourceVersionTo' range, together with the target.

sourceKey.title: Source key
sourceKey.description: The library to match, as 'Title (Company)', for example 'Standard (System)'.

sourceVersionFrom.title: Source version from
sourceVersionFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound of the version range to match.

sourceVersionTo.title: Source version to
sourceVersionTo.description: Inclusive upper bound of the version range to match.

targetKey.title: Target key
targetKey.description: The library to redirect to, as 'Title (Company)', for example 'Standard (System)'.

predicate.title: Predicate
predicate.description: Matches libraries by id and version. Specify either an exact 'version' or a 'versionFrom'/'versionTo' range.

key.title: Key
key.description: The library to match, as 'Title (Company)', for example 'Standard (System)'.

versionFrom.title: Version from
versionFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound of the version range to match.

versionTo.title: Version to
versionTo.description: Inclusive upper bound of the version range to match.
